text:
Clara Zhou: Reminder: company all-hands this Wednesday at 11:00 AM PT in Auditorium A (https://meet.redwood.ai/aud-a). Agenda and slide deck here: https://notion.redwood.ai/p/wed-allhands-2026. Please drop any Qs in the Q&A section by Tuesday 5pm. :calendar:

Devon Lee: I'll present the Launch Readout (5m) 1 metrics + lessons learned. Adding a short timeline slide and the postmortem link.

Priya Nair: Quick policy note: we'll announce the updated data-retention defaults (Hosted -> 30 days). We'll include an "Impact & Opt-out" slide for customers. Draft FAQ is in the deck please review.

Marco: Ops ask: can we enable captions and set recording to auto-upload to drive://company/all-hands/wed-1859990000.mp4 ? ops-bot pls confirm.

ops-bot: Captions enabled. Recording + transcript will upload to drive://company/all-hands/wed-1859990000 within 45 minutes post-meeting. Access: company-wide read. Reminder scheduled 24h and 1h before start. :white_check_mark:

Clara Zhou: Also we'll have a 2-minute customer highlight (Priya), an exec Q&A (15m), and three lightning updates from Eng, Platform, and SRE (3 mins each). If you want to speak, DM me by EOD Tuesday.

Devon Lee: For the Launch Readout I'll need the demo clip queued as fallback. Posting a short recorded screencap in the doc for playback if live demo flaps.

Priya Nair: Added two Qs to the Q&A doc: one about contractual retention for Dedicated customers and another about audit log retention windows.

Marco: FYI incident link for context (last friday caching hiccup): https://status.redwood.ai/2026-03-cache-hiccup. We'll surface mitigations during the SRE update.

Clara Zhou: Recording highlights: we'll pin timestamps for the policy announcement and Launch Readout. If you want a timestamped clip, add a note in the deck with slide times.

Devon Lee: Please mute devices during the lightning updates. Also small ask: close other tabs on the demo machine to avoid notification popups.

Priya Nair: Drafted the customer-facing 3-bullet note to be shared post-all-hands. Added to the comms folder, review welcome.

allhands-bot: Heads-up: all-hands in 2 days at 11:00 AM PT. Recording will be available automatically after the meeting. :bell:

Clara Zhou: Thanks team 1 I'll send a final 9:30 AM PT reminder day-of with speaker order and the live caption link. See you Wednesday. :sparkles:
